definitions.full: H4532. Massah III. מַסָּה proper name, of a location where Israel tried ׳י in the wilderness, Exod 17:7 (JE), Deut 6:16 ; 9:22 ; Psa 95:8 (all ᵐ5 ( ὁ ) πειρασμός ), where Levi was tested Deut 33:8 ( ᵐ5 πείρᾳ ). **See Gall Kultstätten 32 interprets as place of trial (ancient judgment-place) and identification with Kadesh, called also מְרִיבָה (מֵי) and מִשְׁמָּט עֵין .
